From debf8326a435ac746f48173e4742a574810f1ff4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Xu Yang <xu.yang_2@nxp.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 19:16:46 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] phy: fsl-imx8mq-usb: set platform driver data

Add missing platform_set_drvdata() as the data will be used in remove().

Fixes: b58f0f86fd61 ("phy: fsl-imx8mq-usb: add tca function driver for imx95")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Xu Yang <xu.yang_2@nxp.com>
Reviewed-by: Frank Li <Frank.Li@nxp.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260120111646.3159766-1-xu.yang_2@nxp.com
Signed-off-by: Vinod Koul <vkoul@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/phy/freescale/phy-fsl-imx8mq-usb.c b/drivers/phy/freescale/phy-fsl-imx8mq-usb.c
index 7b7b486a2078..6c5f8271c52d 100644
--- a/drivers/phy/freescale/phy-fsl-imx8mq-usb.c
+++ b/drivers/phy/freescale/phy-fsl-imx8mq-usb.c
@@ -696,6 +696,8 @@ static int imx8mq_usb_phy_probe(struct platform_device *pdev)
 	if (!imx_phy)
 		return -ENOMEM;
 
+	platform_set_drvdata(pdev, imx_phy);
+
 	imx_phy->clk = devm_clk_get(dev, "phy");
 	if (IS_ERR(imx_phy->clk)) {
 		dev_err(dev, "failed to get imx8mq usb phy clock\n");
-- 
2.34.1

The patch adds a missing `platform_set_drvdata()` call in the probe function of the `imx8mq_usb_phy` driver. This ensures that the `imx_phy` structure is stored as the platform driver data, making it accessible in the `remove()` function (via `platform_get_drvdata()`), which previously would have received `NULL` and caused a bug.

**Modifications per file:**

- **drivers/phy/freescale/phy-fsl-imx8mq-usb.c**  
  In `imx8mq_usb_phy_probe()`, immediately after allocating the `imx_phy` structure and checking for allocation failure, added:
  ```c
  platform_set_drvdata(pdev, imx_phy);
  ```

**Relationship between modifications:**  
Only one file is modified with a single addition. This change fixes a missing data assignment that breaks the remove path, as the driver data is required during device removal (e.g., to clean up resources associated with the `imx_phy` structure).

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
In the probe function `imx8mq_usb_phy_probe`, the call `platform_set_drvdata(pdev, imx_phy);` is missing.
In the remove function, the call `imx_phy = platform_get_drvdata(pdev);` will return NULL because driver data was never set.
Reason:
Without `platform_set_drvdata()` in the probe function, the driver data pointer (imx_phy) is not stored in the platform device. Consequently, when the remove function uses `platform_get_drvdata(pdev)`, it gets NULL, leading to a null pointer dereference or incorrect cleanup.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
In the probe function, add: `platform_set_drvdata(pdev, imx_phy);`
Reason:
By calling `platform_set_drvdata()` immediately after allocating the private data structure, the driver data is properly stored. Then, any subsequent call to `platform_get_drvdata(pdev)` (e.g., in the remove function) will retrieve the correct pointer, preventing null pointer dereferences and ensuring proper resource cleanup.
